body:
It was a long-anticipated accomplishment to make my way to actually committing the act. I had obtained the salvia through a trip to the beach, where the substance is sold frequently.
It's not something I wanted to use to frequently, and I doubt I would enjoy it as much if I did. The fact that it is a 10x extract also helped to dissuade me from going through such a rare experience too quickly. After watching a movie with my mother, my house was completely asleep with only a lonely teenager looking for entertainment still about.
I carefully and quietly went to the basement, kept all the lights off, turned on the Old School rap channel, I was eager to begin and this was the most interesting thing I could find. I used some chloraseptic to prepare my throat for the abuse, and plunged with that one hit. As I held the smoke in, I did not feel any effects, just a light-headedness. But in the second the smoke left my lungs, I was seized from reality. And by seized, I mean seized. I feel like my mind was too small or simply can't remember the beginnings of the trip, but I know how I ended up. It seemed the last line of rap I had heard was endlessly repeating itself in my mind, while I looked down on myself on my sofa. My reality seemed to be of very little consequence as I looked down at my world almost as one of the seat on a ferris wheel. A myriad of different figures, who at the time were distinctly clear and definable, are present running this ferris wheel of realities.
My reality seemed to be of very little consequence as I looked down at my world almost as one of the seat on a ferris wheel. A myriad of different figures, who at the time were distinctly clear and definable, are present running this ferris wheel of realities.
I see all of this, and attempt to keep in mind that I cannot be completely sucked in. This angered the figures, who repeatedly attempted to coax me in being taken away to who knows where. I resist, and when it seems their cause is lost, they give up on me for the moment at least. As they gave up, I get one last good look at this zoomed out view of the universe, blink, and then arrive back at my own. The last line of rap music I heard that was constantly repeating slowly begins to fade away and meld with the actual music I am hearing, marking the end of the the most intense effects. The bowl in my hand as well as the reality I am in does not compare to the experience, and I attempt to return by closing my eyes and focusing, but to no avail. I sigh and begin the general clean-up process, and return upstairs.
Pretty intense to say the least, but not too intense as to make the trip unenjoyable. The aftereffects are also pleasant and I certainly plan to use salvia again.
